verdict.rationale: BILL's own product page says S&E's AI-powered spend management keeps every card transaction 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant'. It also documents two-way sync with major ERPs, which supports coding at the point of spend feeding month-end close. That rests on one marketing claim. The Invoice Coding Agent applies to AP bills, not card spend, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of receipt capture or matching, memo capture, merchant-level coding detail, how coding flows to the GL per transaction, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
